10.e: Uncultivated land is less reprehensible than cultivated land; and among cows, goats, sheep, gold, grains, and food each preceding one is less reprehensible than the succeeding.

10.s: sapta vittāgamā dharmyā dāyo lābhaḥ krayo jayaḥ prayogaḥ karmayogaśca satpratigraha eva ca
10.d: सप्त वित्तागमा धर्म्या दायो लाभः क्रयो जयः प्रयोगः कर्मयोगश्च सत्प्रतिग्रह एव च
10.e: There are seven lawful sources of income: inheritance, acquisition, purchase, conquest, investment, industry and receiving of proper gifts.

10.s: vidyā śilpaṃ bhṛtiḥ sevā gorakṣyaṃ vipaṇiḥ kṛṣiḥ dhṛtirbhaikṣaṃ kusīdaṃ ca daśa jīvanahetavaḥ
10.d: विद्या शिल्पं भृतिः सेवा गोरक्ष्यं विपणिः कृषिः धृतिर्भैक्षं कुसीदं च दश जीवनहेतवः
10.e: Learning, handicrafts, working on hire, service, cattle-tending, trade, agriculture, contentment, begging and money-lending,—these are the ten means of livelihood.

10.s: brāhmaṇaḥ kṣatriyo vā 'pi vṛddhiṃ naiva prayojayet kāmaṃ tu khalu dharmārthaṃ dadyāt pāpīyase 'lpikām
10.d: ब्राह्मणः क्षत्रियो वा ऽपि वृद्धिं नैव प्रयोजयेत् कामं तु खलु धर्मार्थं दद्यात् पापीयसे ऽल्पिकाम्
10.e: TheBrāhmaṇaor theKṣatriyamust not lend money on interest; but he may advance a little to unrighteous men for sacred purposes.

10.s: caturthamādadāno 'pi kṣatriyo bhāgamāpadi prajā rakṣan paraṃ śaktyā kilbiṣāt pratimucyate
10.d: चतुर्थमाददानो ऽपि क्षत्रियो भागमापदि प्रजा रक्षन् परं शक्त्या किल्बिषात् प्रतिमुच्यते
10.e: TheKṣatriya, who, in times of distress, takes the fourth fart, becomes freed from sin, if he protects the people to the best of his ability.

10.s: svadharmo vijayastasya nāhave syāt parālgmukhaḥ śastreṇa vaiśyān rakṣitvā dharmyamāhārayedbalim vaiśyādrakṣitvā
10.d: स्वधर्मो विजयस्तस्य नाहवे स्यात् पराल्ग्मुखः शस्त्रेण वैश्यान् रक्षित्वा धर्म्यमाहारयेद्बलिम् वैश्याद्रक्षित्वा
10.e: Conquest is his peculiar duty; and he should never turn back in danger; he shall realise the legal tax from the Vaiśya, after protecting the people;

10.s: dhānye 'ṣṭamaṃ viśāṃ śulkaṃ viṃśaṃ kārṣāpaṇāvaram karmaupakaraṇāḥ śūdrāḥ kāravaḥ śilpinastathā
10.d: धान्ये ऽष्टमं विशां शुल्कं विंशं कार्षापणावरम् कर्मौपकरणाः शूद्राः कारवः शिल्पिनस्तथा
10.e: From the people the tax on grains shall be one-eighth, and one-twentieth (on gold), with the minimum of one ‘Kārṣāpaṇa’;Śūdras, craftsmen and artisans discharge their dues by work.

10.s: śūdrastu vṛttimākāṅkṣan kṣatramārādhayedyadi ārādhayediti dhaninaṃ vā 'pyupārādhya vaiśyaṃ śūdro jijīviṣet
10.d: शूद्रस्तु वृत्तिमाकाङ्क्षन् क्षत्रमाराधयेद्यदि आराधयेदिति धनिनं वा ऽप्युपाराध्य वैश्यं शूद्रो जिजीविषेत्
10.e: Sanskrit text, Unicode transliteration and English translation by Ganganath Jha:

10.s: svargārthamubhayārthaṃ vā viprānārādhayet tu saḥ jātabrāhmaṇaśabdasya sā hyasya kṛtakṛtyatā
10.d: स्वर्गार्थमुभयार्थं वा विप्रानाराधयेत् तु सः जातब्राह्मणशब्दस्य सा ह्यस्य कृतकृत्यता
10.e: He shall serveBrāhmaṇaseither for the sake of heaven, or for the sake of both; when, he has attained the title of the ‘Brāhmaṇa,’ this implies the accomplishment of all his purposes.

10.s: viprasevaiva śūdrasya viśiṣṭaṃ karma kīrtyate yadato 'nyaddhi kurute tadbhavatyasya niṣphalam
10.d: विप्रसेवैव शूद्रस्य विशिष्टं कर्म कीर्त्यते यदतो ऽन्यद्धि कुरुते तद्भवत्यस्य निष्फलम्
10.e: The service of theBrāhmaṇais described as the distinctive duty of theŚūdra; everything else that he does is fruitless for him.

10.s: prakalpyā tasya tairvṛttiḥ svakuṭumbādyathārhataḥ śaktiṃ cāvekṣya dākṣyaṃ ca bhṛtyānāṃ ca parigraham
10.d: प्रकल्प्या तस्य तैर्वृत्तिः स्वकुटुम्बाद्यथार्हतः शक्तिं चावेक्ष्य दाक्ष्यं च भृत्यानां च परिग्रहम्
10.e: They should provide out of their family, a suitable maintenance for him, after considering his own capacity, and the man’s skill and the burden of persons to be supported by him.

10.s: ucchiṣṭamannaṃ dātavyaṃ jīrṇāni vasanāni ca pulākāścaiva dhānyānāṃ jīrṇāścaiva paricchadāḥ
10.d: उच्छिष्टमन्नं दातव्यं जीर्णानि वसनानि च पुलाकाश्चैव धान्यानां जीर्णाश्चैव परिच्छदाः
10.e: Remnants of food and worn-out clothes shall be given to him; as also the grain-refuse and old furniture.

10.s: na śūdre pātakaṃ kiṃ cinna ca saṃskāramarhati nāsyādhikāro dharme 'sti na dharmāt pratiṣedhanam
10.d: न शूद्रे पातकं किं चिन्न च संस्कारमर्हति नास्याधिकारो धर्मे ऽस्ति न धर्मात् प्रतिषेधनम्
10.e: For theŚūdrathere is no sin; nor is he worthy of any sacraments; he is not entitled to any sacred rites; but there is no prohibition against sacred rites.

10.s: dharmaipsavastu dharmajñāḥ satāṃ vṛttamanuṣṭhitāḥ satāṃ dharmaṃ mantravarjyaṃ na duṣyanti praśaṃsāṃ prāpnuvanti ca mantravarjaṃ
10.d: धर्मैप्सवस्तु धर्मज्ञाः सतां वृत्तमनुष्ठिताः सतां धर्मं मन्त्रवर्ज्यं न दुष्यन्ति प्रशंसां प्राप्नुवन्ति च मन्त्रवर्जं
10.e: If those who, knowing their duty, and wishing to acquire merit, imitate the practices of righteous men, with the exception of reciting the sacred texts, they incur no guilt; they obtain praise.

10.s: yathā yathā hi sadvṛttamātiṣṭhatyanasūyakaḥ tathā tathaimaṃ cāmuṃ ca lokaṃ prāpnotyaninditaḥ
10.d: यथा यथा हि सद्वृत्तमातिष्ठत्यनसूयकः तथा तथैमं चामुं च लोकं प्राप्नोत्यनिन्दितः
10.e: As theŚūdra, free from envy, maintains the right course of conduct, so does he, free from blame, gain this world and the next.

10.s: śaktenāpi hi śūdreṇa na kāryo dhanasañcayaḥ śūdro hi dhanamāsādya brāhmaṇāneva bādhate
10.d: शक्तेनापि हि शूद्रेण न कार्यो धनसञ्चयः शूद्रो हि धनमासाद्य ब्राह्मणानेव बाधते
10.e: Even though he be able, theŚūdrashall not amass wealth; for having acquired wealth, theŚūdraharasses theBrāhmaṇas.

10.s: ete caturṇāṃ varṇānāmāpaddharmāḥ prakīrtitāḥ yān samyaganutiṣṭhanto vrajanti paramaṃ gatim
10.d: एते चतुर्णां वर्णानामापद्धर्माः प्रकीर्तिताः यान् सम्यगनुतिष्ठन्तो व्रजन्ति परमं गतिम्
10.e: The duties or the four castes in times or distress have thus been expounded; by properly carrying out which they attain the highest state.

10.s: eṣa dharmavidhiḥ kṛtsnaścāturvarṇyasya kīrtitaḥ ataḥ paraṃ pravakṣyāmi prāyaścittavidhiṃ śubham
10.d: एष धर्मविधिः कृत्स्नश्चातुर्वर्ण्यस्य कीर्तितः अतः परं प्रवक्ष्यामि प्रायश्चित्तविधिं शुभम्
